supplemental_validation.limit: XRG broad decomposition checks were not rerun: the closure brief is manifest-bounded and ContextBudgetQA.csv is not a sealed member. Accepted identity/parent/scope/objective sets were independently compared directly against sealed Deliverables.csv; manager XRG claims are not substituted for these checks.

custom_check_method.operations: Python standard-library csv.DictReader, hashlib.sha256, exact string membership; git show read-only comparison. No duplicate graph algorithm.
custom_check_method.manifest: For each sha256/path entry, compare working bytes and git show SOURCE_REVISION:repo/path SHA256.
custom_check_method.inventory: Compare canonical DeliverableID set to live PKG-*/lifecycle/DEL-* folder IDs.
custom_check_method.source_preservation: Compare each ScopeOfWork.md hash against DEPENDENCY_WORK_ITEMS.csv SourceSHA256.
custom_check_method.declaration_preservation: Compare _DEPENDENCIES.md prefix before ## Extracted Dependency Register byte-for-byte with git show ddd721a90ade401d452d102e6e40d1ffdae654eb:path.
custom_check_method.row_source: Assert every EvidenceQuote is an exact substring in its local ScopeOfWork.md. This is quote validity, not semantic proof.
custom_check_method.anchors: Exactly one active IMPLEMENTS_NODE with TargetRefID equal accepted PackageID; nonblank TargetPackageID must agree. Compare active REQUIREMENT target set to CoversScopeItems union SupportsObjectives.
custom_check_method.package_reconciliation: Find active DELIVERABLE rows at opposite end in the named package with reverse Direction; review actual contribution rather than treat any match as complete coverage.

semantic_review.scope: Every intra-SCC row and actual local supporting clauses; all UNKNOWN source clauses; package-level rows and named opposite-end support; varied provider, human, owner, witness, record and adoption source clauses. Not exhaustive semantic certification of all 402 execution rows.
semantic_review.finding: No concrete source-fidelity defect established in examined material; production allocation and actual input fulfilment remain unresolved.
